evidence: The event sender initially stores the supplied object in both event words 0 and 1 and the supplied parameter at offset 16. On bubbling, the dispatcher obtains the parent of word 0 and replaces word 0 before recursive dispatch; word 1 is left unchanged. Three veneers branch to the corresponding SRAM leaf getters. These semantics are based on this firmware and do not assume upstream field order.
scope: each getter affects all callers; return values are pointer words with event-dependent object and lifetime
limitations: Do not replace pointers unless the replacement satisfies the specific caller contract. Shared-entry install and rollback require system-wide quiescence; static analysis and relocation tests do not validate device behavior.
